Krug se kreće i peva:

> Sedi, Jaša, ti si naša zabava!  
> Grickaj orahe za svoju razonodu,  
> Položi ruke i pogodi ime!

- Posle pesme Jaša ustaje zatvorenih očiju, podiže ruke i ide napred dok nekoga ne dodirne.
- Dodirom kose, ušiju ili odeće pokušava da pogodi ime.
- Ako pogodi, ta osoba postaje novi voditelj; inače pokušava ponovo.

**3. Dodatna pravila**

- Svi ćute da bi bilo teže pogoditi.
- Niko ne menja mesto.
- Jaša mora da izgovori neko ime, čak i ako nije siguran.

Zabavna igra za dečje kampove i proslave!
### **Игра «Сиди, Яша!» 🎭👀** \n\n✨ **Ве.en:
### **Сиди, Яша!**

A cheerful guessing game of trust and attentiveness.

#### Age

5+ years

#### Purpose

- Develop tactile recognition of people.
- Practise memory and attention.
- Create trust within the group.

#### How to play

**1. Preparation**

- Best played among people who know one another, since the task is to recognise someone by touch.
- Children form a circle and Yasha sits in the centre with eyes closed.

**2. Play**

The circle moves and sings:

> Sit, Yasha, our amusement!  
> Nibble nuts for your fun,  
> Lay your hands on someone and name them correctly!

- After the song Yasha stands with eyes closed, raises his arms and walks forward until he touches someone.
- By touching hair, ears or clothing, he tries to guess the person's name.
- If correct, that player becomes the new leader; if wrong, Yasha tries again.

**3. Additional rules**

- Everyone must stay silent to make guessing harder.
- Nobody changes position.
- Yasha must offer a name even if unsure.

A fun game for children's camps and parties!

### **Игра «Умер покойник»** ⚰️🎭 \n\n✨.sr:
### **Умер покойник**

Vesela scenska igra pokreta, koordinacije, sluha i glume.

#### Uzrast

4+ godina

#### Cilj igre

- Koordinacija i motorika.
- Slušno opažanje i pamćenje.
- Emocionalno izražavanje i gluma.

#### Kako se igra

**1. Priprema**

- U sredinu stavite klupu ili nekoliko stolica.
- Jedan igrač leži prekrštenih ruku na grudima i zatvorenih očiju.
- Ostali se drže za ruke u krugu oko klupe.

**2. Tok igre**

Igrači pevaju, a pokojnik izvodi pokrete:

| Reči pesme | Pokret pokojnika |
|---|---|
| „Umro pokojnik u sredu, u utorak, došli da ga sahrane, na klupi leži…” | Leži nepomično, zatvorenih očiju. |
| „Nogama mrda…” | Počinje da pomera noge. |
| „Rukama mrda…” | Dodaje pokrete ruku. |
| „Na klupi sedi…” | Seda, i dalje pomera ruke i noge. |
| „Očima gleda…” | Otvara oči i trepće. |
| „Za nama trči!” | Skače i hvata nekoga iz kruga. |

**3. Završetak kruga**

Uhvaćeni postaje novi pokojnik i igra se ponavlja.

Igra razvija glumu, pažnju i koordinaciju, uz mnogo smeha!
### **Игра «Умер покойник»** ⚰️🎭 \n\n✨.en:
### **Умер покойник**

A cheerful theatrical movement game for coordination, listening and acting.

#### Age

4+ years

#### Purpose

- Coordination and motor skills.
- Auditory perception and memory.
- Emotional expression and acting.

#### How to play

**1. Preparation**

- Place a bench or several chairs in the centre.
- One player lies down with arms crossed on their chest and eyes closed.
- The others hold hands in a circle around the bench.

**2. Play**

The players sing and the dead man acts out the words:

| Song lyrics | Dead man's action |
|---|---|
| “The dead man died on Wednesday, on Tuesday; they came to bury him, he lies on a bench…” | Lies motionless, eyes closed. |
| “He moves his legs…” | Begins moving legs. |
| “He moves his arms…” | Adds arm movements. |
| “He sits on the bench…” | Sits up while moving arms and legs. |
| “He looks with his eyes…” | Opens eyes and blinks. |
| “He runs after us!” | Jumps up and catches someone from the circle. |

**3. End of the round**

The captured player becomes the new dead man and the game repeats.

The game develops acting, attentiveness and coordination, with lots of laughter!

### **Игра «Корзиночки»** 🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️\n\n✨.sr:
### **Корзиночки**

Aktivna igra brzine i spretnosti koja razvija koordinaciju i saradnju.

#### Uzrast

4+ godina

#### Cilj igre

- Brzina i spretnost.
- Brzo donošenje odluka i saradnja u paru.
- Koordinacija pokreta.

#### Kako se igra

**1. Priprema**

- Učesnici se podele u parove.
- Parovi stanu u krug ili red držeći se za ruke.

**2. Tok igre**

- Jedan igrač iz para počinje da beži u krugu.
- Može da se zameni sa bilo kojim drugim igračem.
- Prilazi drugom paru i stavlja ruke odozgo na jednog igrača.
- Dodirnuti igrač sada trči za drugim i pokušava da ga uhvati.

| Situacija | Radnja |
|---|---|
| Jedan igrač beži | Može promeniti par stavljanjem ruku na drugog igrača. |
| Drugi igrač u paru | Dodirnuti igrač počinje da juri prvog. |

**3. Završetak kruga**

- Igra traje dok svi ne zamene mesta ili ne budu uhvaćeni.
- Pobeđuje par koji najbrže menja mesta i izbegava hvatanje.

Igra razvija brzinu, odlučivanje u pokretu i saradnju!
### **Игра «Корзиночки»** 🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️\n\n✨.en:
### **Корзиночки**

An active game of speed and agility, developing coordination and teamwork.

#### Age

4+ years

#### Purpose

- Speed and agility.
- Quick decisions and cooperation in pairs.
- Coordination of movement.

#### How to play

**1. Preparation**

- Players form pairs.
- Pairs stand in a circle or line, holding hands.

**2. Play**

- One player from a pair starts running around the circle.
- The runner may exchange places with another player.
- To do so, approach another pair and place your hands on one of its players from above.
- The touched player now chases the other and tries to catch them.

| Situation | Action |
|---|---|
| One player runs away | May change pairs by placing hands on another player. |
| Second player in a pair | The touched player begins chasing the first. |

**3. End of the round**

- Continue until everyone has swapped places or been caught.
- The quickest pair to change places while avoiding capture wins.

The game develops speed, decision-making on the move and teamwork!

### **Игра «Номера» (или «Ремень») 🔢**\n.sr:
### **Ремень**

Dinamična igra „Brojevi” za pažnju, brzinu i brzo snalaženje.

#### Uzrast

6+ godina

#### Cilj igre

- Pažnja i reakcija.
- Pamćenje i koordinacija.
- Aktivno učešće svih igrača i održavanje dinamike.

#### Kako se igra

**1. Priprema**

- Podelite učesnike na unutrašnji krug (stoje) i spoljašnji (trče).
- Unutrašnjem krugu tajno se dodeljuju brojevi, na primer 12–19, prema broju učesnika.
- Spoljašnji igrači dobijaju zadatak da pozovu broj, ali ne znaju kome pripada.

**2. Tok igre**

- Voditelj kaže broj, na primer 12; igrač sa tim brojem brzo prilazi, a ostali prate.
- Ako okleva ili zaboravi broj, voditelj ga podseća i ubrzava igru.
- Spoljašnji krug je glasnik: trkači pozivaju broj i pokušavaju da pronađu odgovarajućeg igrača.
- Mogu menjati brojeve; voditelj ponavlja dok svi ne učestvuju.

| Situacija | Radnja |
|---|---|
| Poziva se broj 12 | Igrač sa brojem 12 trči do voditelja. |
| Igrač zaboravi broj | Voditelj ga podseća i pomaže mu da brže reaguje. |
| Spoljašnji krug | Poziva broj i traži odgovarajućeg igrača. |

**3. Smena uloga**

Posle nekoliko krugova zamenite unutrašnji i spoljašnji krug i dodelite nove brojeve.

**4. Završetak**

Igra traje dok svi ne zamene mesta ili voditelj odluči da završi.
### **Игра «Номера» (или «Ремень») 🔢**\n.en:
### **Ремень**

A dynamic game called “Numbers”, involving attention, speed and quick reactions.

#### Age

6+ years

#### Purpose

- Attention and reaction speed.
- Memory and coordination.
- Keep everyone actively involved and the game dynamic.

#### How to play

**1. Preparation**

- Divide players into an inner circle (standing) and an outer circle (running).
- Secretly assign numbers to inner players, for example 12–19 depending on the group size.
- Outer players are told to call numbers without knowing who has them.

**2. Play**

- The leader calls a number, for example 12; the numbered player approaches quickly and everyone watches.
- If they hesitate or forget, the leader reminds them and keeps things moving.
- The outer circle acts as messengers: runners call a number and try to find the correct player in time.
- The outer players may change numbers and the leader repeats until everyone is involved.

| Situation | Action |
|---|---|
| Number 12 is called | Player 12 runs to the leader. |
| A player forgets their number | The leader reminds them and helps them react faster. |
| Outer circle | Calls a number and tries to find the correct player. |

**3. Changing roles**

After several rounds, swap the outer and inner circles and assign new numbers.

**4. Finish**

Continue until everyone has exchanged places or the leader ends the game.

### **Игра «Ванька и Манька»** 🎭 \n\n✨.sr:
### **Жмурки (Ванька и Манька)**

Vesela taktilna igra za pažnju, sluh i snalaženje u prostoru.

#### Uzrast

4+ godina

#### Cilj igre

- Koordinacija i slušno opažanje.
- Koncentracija i reakcija.
- Osećaj prostora i orijentacija.

#### Kako se igra

**1. Uloge**

- Dva igrača sa povezom preko očiju.
- Ostala deca čine krug koji obezbeđuje prostor za igru.

**2. Priprema**

- Vežite igračima oči maramama.
- Zavrtite ih u mestu da se teže orijentišu.

Dijalog pre početka:

> — Na čemu stojiš?  
> — Na mostu.  
> — Šta piješ?  
> — Kvas.  
> — Tri godine…  
> — Ne miševe!

**3. Pravila**

- Jedan traži drugog: „Liza, gde si?”
- Drugi odgovara „Ovde sam!” i beži.
- Mogu zavarati protivnika promenom smera glasa.
- Krug sprečava izlazak iz prostora radi bezbednosti.
- Kada jedan dodirne drugog, uloge se menjaju.

**4. Završetak**

Posle hvatanja novi voditelj imenuje zamenu; igra se nastavlja sa novim učesnicima.

Igra vežba sluh, reakciju i opažanje prostora!
### **Игра «Ванька и Манька»** 🎭 \n\n✨.en:
### **Жмурки (Ванька и Манька)**

A cheerful tactile game developing attention, hearing and spatial orientation.

#### Age

4+ years

#### Purpose

- Coordination and auditory perception.
- Concentration and reaction speed.
- Spatial awareness and orientation.

#### How to play

**1. Roles**

- Two blindfolded players.
- Other children form a circle to create a safe play area.

**2. Preparation**

- Blindfold the two players with scarves.
- Spin them around to make orientation harder.

Questions and answers before the start:

> — What are you standing on?  
> — A bridge.  
> — What are you drinking?  
> — Kvass.  
> — Three years…  
> — Not mice!

**3. Rules**

- One player seeks the other: “Liza, where are you?”
- The other replies “I'm here!” and runs away.
- Players may mislead by changing the direction of their voice.
- The circle keeps them within the safe playing area.
- On contact the players swap roles.

**4. End of the round**

After the catch the new leader names a replacement; the game continues with new players.

A fun way to practise hearing, reaction speed and spatial awareness!

### **Игра «Где квас варят?»** 🏃‍♂️🎭 \n.sr:
### **Где квас варят**

Vesela pokretna igra za reakciju, pažnju i koordinaciju.

#### Uzrast

4+ godina

#### Cilj igre

- Pažnja i brzina reakcije.
- Koordinacija pokreta i timski rad.
- Govorne veštine kroz rimovane odgovore.

#### Kako se igra

**1. Priprema**

- Deca stoje u krugu, rame uz rame, bez praznih mesta.
- Voditelj hoda izvan kruga.

**2. Tok igre**

- Voditelj izabere nekoga i dotakne ga po ramenu.
- Okrenu se licem jedno prema drugom, rukuju i izgovore:

> — Gde kuvaju kvas?  
> — Iza brda, iza kobilje jazbine!

- Oboje trče u suprotnim smerovima oko kruga do praznog mesta.
- Ko izgubi postaje novi voditelj.

**3. Dodatna pravila**

- Deca se drže za ruke da niko ne zauzme mesto prerano.
- Ne viriti i ne puštati ruke pre vremena.
- Onaj ko ne zauzme mesto postaje novi voditelj.

Vesela, aktivna igra za grupu dece!
### **Игра «Где квас варят?»** 🏃‍♂️🎭 \n.en:
### **Где квас варят**

A cheerful movement game that develops reaction speed, attention and coordination.

#### Age

4+ years

#### Purpose

- Attention and quick reactions.
- Coordination and teamwork.
- Speech skills through rhyming replies.

#### How to play

**1. Preparation**

- Children stand shoulder to shoulder in a circle without gaps.
- One leader walks outside the circle.

**2. Play**

- The leader chooses someone and taps their shoulder.
- They face each other, shake hands and say:

> — Where is kvass brewed?  
> — Beyond the hill, beyond the mare's burrow!

- Both run in opposite directions around the circle towards the vacant place.
- The loser becomes the next leader.

**3. Additional rules**

- Children hold hands to prevent a runner from taking the place too early.
- No peeking or letting go early.
- Whoever fails to take the place becomes the leader.

An active and engaging game for a group of children!

### **«Бояре, мы к вам пришли!»** \n\n🎉.sr:
### **Бояре, мы к вам пришли!**

#### Cilj igre

- Razvijanje timskog duha, zajedništva i spretnosti.
- Veselo druženje na svežem vazduhu.

#### Uzrast

6+ godina

#### Broj učesnika

10–20, po želji i više.

#### Kako se igra

**1. Priprema**

Podelite učesnike na dve približno jednake ekipe po broju i snazi. Stanite jedni naspram drugih na udaljenosti 10–15 metara.

**2. Raspored**

Svaka ekipa se poređa u liniju i uhvati za ruke. Počinju uvodni stihovi:

> Bojari, došli smo vam!  
> Dragi naši, došli smo vam!

*Koraci napred.*

> Bojari, zašto ste došli?  
> Dragi naši, zašto ste došli?

*Koraci nazad.*

**3. Odgovori druge ekipe**

> Bojari, treba nam nevesta!  
> Dragi naši, treba nam nevesta!

> Bojari, kakva vam treba?  
> Dragi naši, kakva vam treba?

**4. Izbor igrača**

> Bojari, ova nam je draga!  
> Dragi naši, ova nam je draga!

Izgovorite ime igrača protivničke ekipe; izabrani igrač se okreće leđima protivnicima.

**5. Lanac i nevesta**

> Bojari, bole je zubi!  
> Dragi naši, bole je zubi!

> Bojari, daćemo joj medenjak!  
> Dragi naši, daćemo joj medenjak!

> Bojari, ona ne jede medenjake!  
> Dragi naši, ona ne jede medenjake!

> Bojari, onda ćemo bičem!  
> Dragi naši, onda ćemo bičem!

> Bojari, ona se biča boji!  
> Dragi naši, ona se biča boji!

> Bojari, otvorite kapiju!  
> Dajte nam nevestu zauvek!

**6. Pokušaj proboja**

Izabrana nevesta pokušava da probije protivnički lanac ruku i vrati se svojoj ekipi.

- Ako ne uspe, prelazi u protivničku ekipu.
- Ako razdvoji ruke protivnika, vraća se svojoj ekipi i vodi jednog protivnika.

#### Završetak igre

Igra traje dok jedna ekipa ne stekne brojčanu prednost. Pobeđuje ekipa koja osvoji sve protivnike ili, kod velikog broja učesnika, privuče više igrača.

Igra razvija timski rad, brzu reakciju i izdržljivost; odlična je za praznike i druženja na otvorenom.
### **«Бояре, мы к вам пришли!»** \n\n🎉.en:
### **Бояре, мы к вам пришли!**

#### Purpose

- Develop team spirit, cohesion and agility.
- Enjoy spending time outdoors.

#### Age

6+ years

#### Number of players

10–20, or more if desired.

#### How to play

**1. Preparation**

Divide players into two teams of roughly equal size and strength. The teams face each other about 10–15 metres apart.

**2. Formation**

Each team forms a line and holds hands. Begin with the opening verses:

> Boyars, we have come to you!  
> Dear ones, we have come to you!

*Steps forward.*

> Boyars, why have you come?  
> Dear ones, why have you come?

*Steps back.*

**3. The second team's responses**

> Boyars, we need a bride!  
> Dear ones, we need a bride!

> Boyars, which one do you need?  
> Dear ones, which one do you need?

**4. Choosing a player**

> Boyars, this one is dear to us!  
> Dear ones, this one is dear to us!

Name a player from the opposing team; the chosen player turns their back to the opponents.

**5. The chain and the bride**

> Boyars, her teeth hurt!  
> Dear ones, her teeth hurt!

> Boyars, we'll give her gingerbread!  
> Dear ones, we'll give her gingerbread!

> Boyars, she doesn't eat gingerbread!  
> Dear ones, she doesn't eat gingerbread!

> Boyars, then we'll use a whip!  
> Dear ones, then we'll use a whip!

> Boyars, she's afraid of the whip!  
> Dear ones, she's afraid of the whip!

> Boyars, open the gates!  
> Give us the bride forever!

**6. Attempting the breakthrough**

The chosen bride tries to break the opposing chain of hands and return to their own team.

- If unsuccessful, the bride joins the opposing team.
- If the opponents' hands come apart, the bride returns to their own team and takes one opposing player along.

#### End of the game

Continue until one team has a numerical advantage. The winner captures all opponents or, with a large group, gains more players than the other team.

The game develops teamwork, quick reactions and endurance; it is excellent for festivals and outdoor gatherings.

Zove se… (razuzdano veselje)
Он и чистый, и широкий –\nТо четверг уж.en:
Both clean and broad,
Thursday is at the door.
Don't dawdle on this day,
It's called… (Revelry)

По традиции по русской\nВ этот день деви.sr:
Po ruskom običaju,
Tog dana devojke tuguju!
A momci, kao i uvek,
Razbežali se na sve strane!
По традиции по русской\nВ этот день деви.en:
According to Russian custom,
The girls are sad that day!
And the boys, as ever,
Have scattered everywhere!

Вот и пятница пришла,\nЗятя в гости прив.sr:
Evo stigao je petak,
Zeta doveo u goste —
Jesti palačinke, sankati se.
To je… (taštino veče)
Вот и пятница пришла,\nЗятя в гости прив.en:
Friday has arrived,
Bringing the son-in-law to visit —
Eat pancakes and slide down hills.
It's… (Mother-in-law's Evening)

К теще зять сегодня мчится,\nЧтоб блинам.sr:
Zet danas žuri tašti,
Da se najede palačinki!
Pufnaste, masne, rumene,
Da zet bude sit i veseo od pića!
К теще зять сегодня мчится,\nЧтоб блинам.en:
The son-in-law rushes to his mother-in-law,
To feast on pancakes!
Fluffy, buttery and golden,
So he'll be full and merry with drink!

А теперь пришла суббота.\nДевкам дома не.sr:
A sada je stigla subota.
Devojkama se ne sedi kod kuće,
Vesele se kao veverice…
Na (sastanku zaova)
А теперь пришла суббота.\nДевкам дома не.en:
And now Saturday is here.
The girls don't want to stay home,
They're as lively as squirrels…
At (Sisters-in-law's Gathering)

Девки скопом ходят в гости,\nПеремоют до.sr:
Devojke u grupi idu u goste,
Operu kuću i pretresu tračeve,
Svaka o svakoj priča,
A na hleb mažu džem.
Девки скопом ходят в гости,\nПеремоют до.en:
The girls visit in groups,
Clean the house and gossip,
Everyone has a story about everyone,
And they spread jam on bread.

День последний подошёл,\nПост закончился.sr:
Poslednji dan je stigao,
Post se završio, prošao!
Slatke i slane palačinke
U nedelju… (oproštaja)
День последний подошёл,\nПост закончился.en:
The final day has come,
The fast is over, gone!
Sweet pancakes and savoury ones
On (Forgiveness Sunday)

Ладно, видно заслужили.\nВсё по полкам р.sr:
Dobro, izgleda da ste zaslužili.
Sve ste lepo objasnili.
Čak mi je dosadno, pu na vas!
Evo vam moje zapovesti!

Da baku ne naljutite,
Napunite kriglu,
Uvijte palačinke s medom
I pomirišite hladan vazduh!
(njuši vazduh)

Napitak ispijte odjednom,
Sve nevolje oterajte u šumu.
Živite punim plućima
I s velikim zanimanjem.

Evo znanja iz šumske dubine:
Da proleće brže prizovete,
Češće se osmehujte,
Hladnoću spalite, a budite dobri!
Ладно, видно заслужили.\nВсё по полкам р.en:
Well, it seems you've earned it.
You've explained everything neatly.
I'm almost bored, pff at you!
Here's my command, then!

To keep Granny from getting angry,
Fill a mug,
Roll your pancakes with honey,
And breathe in the cool air!
(sniffs the air)

Drink the potion in one gulp,
Drive all your troubles into the forest.
Live on a grand scale,
With a great interest in life.

Here's wisdom from the deep woods:
To call spring sooner,
Smile more often,
Burn away the cold, but be kinder!

Как же, бабка, её сжечь?\nНе засунешь зи.sr:
Kako, bako, da je spalimo?
Zimu u peć ne možemo staviti!
Malo si čudna!
Vidi se da si iz šume!
Как же, бабка, её сжечь?\nНе засунешь зи.en:
How, Granny, can we burn it?
We can't put winter in an oven!
You're a little strange!
Clearly you're from the woods!

Ты, малой, поди поближе,\nЧто-то плохо т.sr:
Ti, mali, priđi bliže,
Ne vidim te baš najbolje!
(lakrdijaš prilazi)

Evo ti po kapi! Budalo,
Idi i rasteraj tugu!
Ako dopustiš da se neko smrzne,
Pretvoriću te u bakalar!

Kad zagreješ sve oko sebe,
Priđi, pokazaću ti obrede!
Pokazaću kako se pali,
Da ruke ne opečeš!
Ты, малой, поди поближе,\nЧто-то плохо т.en:
Come closer, little fellow,
I can't see you very well!
(the jester approaches)

Take that on your cap! Fool,
Go and chase away the gloom!
If you let anyone freeze,
I'll turn you into a codfish!

When you've warmed everyone nearby,
Come back and I'll teach you the rites!
I'll show you how to burn it,
Without burning your hands!

Давит мне на мозг колпак —\nЯ поэтому ду.sr:
Kapa mi pritiska mozak —
Zato sam budala!

Ljutiti baku nije pametno,
Da zimu pobedimo,
Znam da vodim igre,
Za mnom svi, ja vodim!

Ko je spreman? Dođite!
Jeste li spremni za igre?
Давит мне на мозг колпак —\nЯ поэтому ду.en:
My cap squeezes my brain —
That's why I'm a fool!

Angering Granny is a bad idea,
To defeat winter,
I know how to play games,
Follow me, I'll lead!

Who's ready? Come here!
Are you ready for games?

Ух, красавцы, хоть куда!\nЕсть тут кто-т.sr:
Uh, kakvi junaci!
Ima li ovde nekog snažnog?
Ух, красавцы, хоть куда!\nЕсть тут кто-т.en:
Oh, what a fine bunch!
Is there anyone strong here?

Нету сил — играть устали,\nБаб Яга, чего.sr:
Nemamo više snage — umorili smo se od igara,
Baba Jago, zašto stojimo?
Reci šta ćemo spaliti,
Da ruke ne opečemo!
Нету сил — играть устали,\nБаб Яга, чего.en:
No strength left — we're tired of playing,
Baba Yaga, why are we standing here?
Tell us what to burn,
Without burning our hands!

Чтобы укротить морозы\nИ предотвратить с.sr:
Da ukrotimo mrazeve
I sprečimo zaboravnost,
Treba prizvati duhove šume
Za čarobni obred.

Čuf-čufir, kurdi-murdi,
Duše proleća, dođi mi!
Чтобы укротить морозы\nИ предотвратить с.en:
To tame the frosts
And ward off forgetfulness,
We must summon forest spirits
For a magical rite.

Chuf-chufyr, kurdy-murdy,
Spirit of Spring, come to me!

Всем поклон! Какие люди!\nВместе веселит.sr:
Pozdrav svima! Kakvi ljudi!
Zajedno ćemo se veseliti!
Ali dok Zima vlada,
Nevolje nisu prestale!

Da udahnem i procvetam,
Moram sasvim doći.
Za to mi je potrebna
Maslenicina pomoć.
Всем поклон! Какие люди!\nВместе веселит.en:
Greetings to you all! What a crowd!
We'll make merry together!
But while Winter holds power,
Our troubles are not over!

To breathe and blossom,
I must arrive in full.
To do so, I somehow need
Maslenitsa's help.

Знаю, ведаю, проникла,\nВласть Зимы ещё.sr:
Znam, shvatam, sve mi je jasno,
Zimina vlast još nije nestala.
Sakrila je Maslenicu,
Proleću zatvorila vrata.

Ne brini, dete prirode.
Dogodilo se nevreme.
Naše Maslenice nema!
Ali imam savet:

Prizovimo je na praznik,
Zapevaj, nestašni lakrdijašu!
Знаю, ведаю, проникла,\nВласть Зимы ещё.en:
I know, I understand, I see,
Winter's power hasn't faded yet.
She has hidden Maslenitsa,
And barred the door to Spring.

Never mind, child of nature.
Bad weather has come.
Our Maslenitsa is missing!
But I have advice:

Let's call her to the festival,
Sing, you mischievous jester!

Эге-гей, честные люди,\nНе грустите, рад.sr:
Hej, čestiti ljudi,
Ne tugujte, biće radosti!
Cele nedelje sam čamila,
I mnogo sam se iznenadila!

Koliko plesa, igara i pesama!
Kako je divan naš narod!
Osećam snagu i radost,
Pobedićemo svaku nevolju!

Da Zimu pobedimo,
Moramo osvojiti lutku.
Još nemam dovoljno snage,
Pomozite mi malo!

U toj lutki je moj spas,
Da se oslobodim zatočeništva,
Pomozite mi, čestita družino,
Predajte lutku vatri!
Эге-гей, честные люди,\nНе грустите, рад.en:
Hey, good people,
Don't be sad, joy will come!
I've been languishing all week,
And what a surprise I've had!

So much dancing, games and singing!
What wonderful people we have!
I feel strength and joy,
We'll defeat every trouble!

To defeat Winter,
We must capture the doll.
My strength is still too small,
Please help me a little!

My salvation lies in that doll,
To free me from imprisonment,
Help me, honourable company,
Give the effigy to the fire!

Как же, как же, разбежались!\nПока в игр.sr:
Ma da, kako da ne!
Dok ste se vi igrali,
Zarobila sam Jagu
I zaledila je u snegu!

Idite svojim kućama!
Od lutke nema ništa!
Как же, как же, разбежались!\nПока в игр.en:
Oh yes, as if!
While you were playing games,
I captured Yaga
And froze her in the snow!

Go home, all of you!
You won't get the effigy!

Не для шутки наши игры!\nНаши молодцы —.sr:
Naše igre nisu šala!
Naši junaci su kao tigrovi!
Zbog Sunca i trave,
Zimo, izazivamo te!

Ko će ovde biti vojvoda?
Ko je najsnažniji u narodu?
Ko će spasiti naš praznik?
Ko je ovde glavni nestaško?
Не для шутки наши игры!\nНаши молодцы —.en:
Our games are no joke!
Our lads are like tigers!
For the Sun and the grass,
Winter, we challenge you!

Who will be our commander?
Who is strongest among the people?
Who will save our festival?
Who's the greatest mischief-maker here?

Я — сильнейший из людей!\nЗаклинаю, Зиму.sr:
Ja sam najsnažniji od svih!
Zaklinjem vas, udrite Zimu!
Я — сильнейший из людей!\nЗаклинаю, Зиму.en:
I am the strongest of all!
I charge you, strike at Winter!

Погоня за Зимой (хороводные песни)\n\nВо.sr:
Potera za Zimom (pesme za kolo)

Vojvodi daju veliku kašiku kao mač. On ide prvi, ostali se hvataju iza njega u zmiju. Cilj je okružiti Zimu kolom i dodirnuti je kašikom po zadnjici. Zima izmiče, pokušava da pobegne, lukava je i vara.
Погоня за Зимой (хороводные песни)\n\nВо.en:
Chasing Winter (circle-dance songs)

The commander receives a large spoon as a sword. He leads while others form a snake-like chain behind him. The aim is to surround Winter in a circle and touch her backside with the spoon. Winter dodges, tries to escape, tricks and deceives the players.

Признаю, уже нет сил!\nВоевода победил!\.sr:
Priznajem, nemam više snage!
Vojvoda je pobedio!
Uzmite šta želite,
Samo me pustite!

Nisam htela da odem,
Ali moram — šta da radim?
Признаю, уже нет сил!\nВоевода победил!\.en:
I admit, I have no strength left!
The commander has won!
Take whatever you want,
Just let me go!

I didn't want to leave,
But I must — what can I do?

Не гневись, Зима, присядь!\nВсё же нужно.sr:
Ne ljuti se, Zimo, sedi!
I tebi treba odmor!
Ne odlaziš zauvek,
Svake godine se vraćaš!
Не гневись, Зима, присядь!\nВсё же нужно.en:
Don't be angry, Winter, sit down!
You need to rest, too!
You're not leaving forever,
You return every year!

Посижу, пожалуй с вами,\nУгощусь слегка.sr:
Pa, sedeću malo s vama,
Počastiću se palačinkama.
Kad već treba da se rastanemo,
Valja nam se i okrepiti!
Посижу, пожалуй с вами,\nУгощусь слегка.en:
Well, I'll sit with you awhile,
Have myself some pancakes.
Since we have to say goodbye,
We might as well have a bite!

Эх, силён честной народ!\nНу-ка, встаньт.sr:
Eh, snažan je čestiti narod!
Hajde, stanite u kolo!
Эх, силён честной народ!\nНу-ка, встаньт.en:
Ah, what strong and honourable people!
Come, form a circle dance!

Разгорись, живая печь!\nНужно чучело нам.sr:
Razgori se, živa peći!
Moramo spaliti lutku!
Разгорись, живая печь!\nНужно чучело нам.en:
Blaze up, living hearth!
We must burn the effigy!

Жару пламени поддай\nМаслянице силу дай!.sr:
Daj plamenu više žara,
Maslenici snagu podari!
Жару пламени поддай\nМаслянице силу дай!.en:
Give the flames more heat,
Give Maslenitsa strength!

Хоровод “Гори-гори ясно, чтобы не погасл.sr:
Kolo uz pesmu „Gori, gori jasno, da se ne ugasi“, dok lutka ne izgori. Mogu se pevati častuške i druge vesele pesme.

Kada lutka izgori, svi odlaze do stolova s palačinkama i pitama da nastave proslavu široke Maslenice! Praznik se nastavlja slobodno. Ljudi jedu, razgovaraju i fotografišu se.
Хоровод “Гори-гори ясно, чтобы не погасл.en:
Circle dance to “Burn, burn brightly, so you don't go out”, until the effigy burns. Chastushki and other noisy songs may be sung.

Once the effigy has burned, everyone heads to the tables with pancakes and pies to continue the celebration of Broad Maslenitsa! The festival continues informally. People eat, chat and take photographs.

Наконец-то чую силу,\nЧто Весна призвать.sr:
Napokon osećam snagu
Koju je Proleće tražilo!
Наконец-то чую силу,\nЧто Весна призвать.en:
At last I feel the strength
Spring asked me to call forth!

Ну, пропала власть моя,\nПокидаю вас, др.sr:
Eto, nestala je moja vlast,
Napuštam vas, prijatelji!
Doviđenja i zbogom,
U decembru me opet dočekajte!
Ну, пропала власть моя,\nПокидаю вас, др.en:
Well, my power is gone,
I'm leaving you, friends!
Goodbye and farewell,
Welcome me again in December!

Вот блины вам – угощенье,\nЧтоб цвело вс.sr:
Evo vam palačinki za čast,
Da sve procveta, bez sumnje!
Uživajte u ptičjoj pesmi
I osmesima dobrih lica!
Вот блины вам – угощенье,\nЧтоб цвело вс.en:
Here are pancakes, a treat for you,
So that everything will bloom, no doubt!
Enjoy the birdsong
And the smiles of friendly faces!

Пока не подтверждено (участие уточняется.en: Not yet confirmed (participation is being arranged).
